description: A chibi Sun Breathing swordsman companion with calm focus and fiery sword animations.

hinokami-dancing-flash.description: A fast forward dash ending in one clean horizontal crescent of fire and falling embers.

hinokami-burning-sun-wheel.displayName: Form 2 Hinokami Kagura Burning Sun Wheel
hinokami-burning-sun-wheel.description: A centered rotating sun wheel of layered flame ribbons, petals and embers.

hinokami-solar-dragon-dance.displayName: Form 3 Hinokami Kagura Solar Dragon Dance
hinokami-solar-dragon-dance.description: The strongest technique: flowing slashes with a massive fire dragon and dense falling embers.

hinokami-flame-dance.description: Two consecutive flaming slashes cross into a bright X-shaped fire trail with falling embers.

hinokami-solar-halo-dragon-head-dance.displayName: Form 5 Hinokami Kagura Solar Halo Dragon Head Dance
hinokami-solar-halo-dragon-head-dance.description: A signature dragon-head halo attack with a forward lunge, spiral flames and dense ember scatter.

hinokami-beneficent-radiance.description: An ultimate solar finishing move with a giant sun halo, expanding rings, fire rain and ember storm.

hinokami-sunflower-thrust.description: A precision thrust through a sunflower-shaped solar bloom with concentric rings and falling embers.

hinokami-fire-wheel.description: An airborne vertical fire wheel that encloses Tanjiro while spinning, then collapses into embers.
